verdict.rationale: Segment supports data portability via Data Storage Destinations (raw data to warehouses, S3, GCS), a Profile API for programmatic querying, and an open Public API with CRUD access to workspace resources, all of which let a user pull their data out in fairly open formats. However, there is no documented single 'export all and leave' feature, no explicit data-portability/exit guarantee, and no independent verification of a full, lock-in-free export process. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk data-export/account-closure workflow, guarantees of open/standard data formats beyond warehouse tables, and third-party corroboration of successful full data migration off the platform.
